Usage

We look forward to the opportunity to work with you.

Nice to meet you. I would like to make a request because I was pleased to see illustrations of various impressions in the media section, ranging from cute, beautiful, and powerful pictures.

I would like to request an illustration of a character named Cu Larza who appears in a game called Border Break. She is a self-proclaimed esper girl with silver hair and a tuft of red mesh on each side. She gives the impression of being aloof and not losing her composure.
I would be happy with either a static dignified look or a composition that makes fun of us and hypnotizes us with five yen coins.
It would be helpful if the address could be turned on/off in a psd layer.
I will be happy to use it on Twitter or as wallpaper on my PC. Thank you very much.
